import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.formula.api import ols

# Load the dataset
invaded_niche = pd.read_csv('/data/invaded_niche_pathways.csv')

# Convert the column names to remove the quotes
invaded_niche.columns = invaded_niche.columns.str.replace('"', '')

# Display the first few rows of the dataset
invaded_niche.head()

# Define the model formula
formula = 'n.gard ~ cropland.1956.50m + urban.1956.50m + habitat + elevation'

# Fit the model
model = ols(formula, data=invaded_niche).fit()

# Perform an ANOVA to check for significant interactions
anova_table = sm.stats.anova_lm(model, typ=2)
anova_table
